signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {α : Type u_2} -> {β : Type u_3} -> {γ : Type u_4} -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring β] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring γ] -> (g : β →ₙ+* γ) -> (f : α →ₙ+* β) -> α →ₙ+* γ

conventions.statement: VTask.comp g f applies f first and g second, matching the standard mathematical convention g ∘ f.
conventions.note: This is the standard 'diagrammatic reverse' argument order seen throughout Mathlib for composition.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} {γ : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring β] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring γ] (g₁ g₂ : β →ₙ+* γ) (f : α →ₙ+* β), g₁ = g₂ → VTask.comp g₁ f = VTask.comp g₂ f

facts.statement: ∃ (f : ℤ →ₙ+* ℤ) (g : ℤ →ₙ+* ℤ), VTask.comp g f ≠ VTask.comp f g
